title: Driver Incentive Terms, Definitions: The Quest Reward Credited
content:
**Quest reward.** The quest reward credited for an earned quest under **Driver Earnings and Wayfare Pro** is the reward amount stated on the quest offer, unchanged. The quest offer is the account's most recently ended quest, the quest offer with the latest window end on the earnings account. The quest reward is rounded half up to the cent once, at the end.

**Where the figure comes from.** The reward amount is read from the quest offer record as issued to the driver's account and credited as stated there.

**Hypothetical offers and the reward credited.**

| Quest offers on the account (window end, stated reward) | Quest settled | Quest reward |
|---|---|---|
| 7 April, 60.00; 14 April, 85.00 | The quest ending 14 April | 85.00 |
| 21 April, 120.00 | The quest ending 21 April | 120.00 |
| 28 April, 74.995 (an unrounded hypothetical figure) | The quest ending 28 April | 75.00 (half up to the cent) |
